note: Each row lists the official page used, how it was checked, and the strength of that check. 'fetched' = full page text retrieved and read; 'excerpt' = text taken from a search-result excerpt of the official page, so the exact wording must be re-checked manually before relying on it; 'observed' = a value read from an Amazon page, dated, and subject to change. 'rechecked' records the most recent pass in which the page itself was fetched and read.

sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.method: fetched 2026-11-20 (full agreement page, §1 and §5 read in full)
sources.used_for: §1 defines 'Special Links' as tagged links in the formats Amazon provides; §5 requires the statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' on the Site; §5 also bars misrepresenting or embellishing the Amazon relationship.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (Participation Requirements, Commission Income Statement, Products Statement, IP License, Trademark Guidelines)
sources.method: fetched 2026-11-20 (Participation Requirements §2(a)-(b), §3, §4, §5, §6(a)-(z) read directly on the page; Commission Income Statement §1)
sources.used_for: Special Links must carry the Associates tag as a URL parameter on every link placed on the Site (§2(b)). Prices and availability may be shown only when Amazon serves them or when obtained through the Creators/PA API (§2(b)); price tracking and alerting is not allowed (§6(y)); customer reviews and star ratings may not be displayed without an API link (§6(t)). Cloaking or obscuring the Site URL, including by redirects, is prohibited (§6(v)). A link shortening service may not be used in a way that makes it unclear the link goes to an Amazon Site (§6(w)). No artificial clicks or Sessions (§6(s)); no purchasing through your own Special Links (§6(u)); no incentives for using Special Links (§6(g)); no customer confusion about the Amazon relationship (§6(l)).

sources.title: Amazon.com Associates Central - Help: Can I change my Associates ID?
sources.used_for: Associates IDs end in '-20' for the US program (the software adds '-20'); additional tracking IDs are requested through Customer Service.

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google (rel="sponsored")
sources.used_for: rel="sponsored" marks advertisements and paid placements (commonly paid links); rel="nofollow" is the fallback when other values do not apply. Links carrying these values will generally not be followed, but the pages may still be discovered another way.

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.used_for: Disclosures must be hard to miss, placed with the endorsement, and in the same language. Disclosures that appear only on an About page or behind a 'more' link are likely to be missed. 'sp', 'spon', 'collab' and stand-alone 'thanks' or 'ambassador' are too vague.

sources.title: 16 CFR Part 255 - Guides Concerning Use of Endorsements and Testimonials in Advertising
sources.publisher: U.S. Federal Trade Commission / eCFR (U.S. Government Publishing Office)
sources.used_for: Definition of endorsement (§255.0(b)), general considerations (§255.1), and disclosure of material connections (§255.5). Used as the legal reference for disclosure placement on every page.

sources.title: Safe Minimum Internal Temperature Chart
sources.publisher: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
sources.updated: Last Updated: Apr 14, 2025 (as stated on the page)
sources.used_for: Safe minimum internal temperatures as published: beef, pork, veal and lamb steaks, chops and roasts 145 °F with a 3-minute rest; ground meats 160 °F; all poultry including ground poultry 165 °F; fish and shellfish 145 °F; leftovers and casseroles 165 °F; eggs 160 °F.

sources.title: Food Thermometers
sources.publisher: USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service
sources.method: fetched 2026-11-20 (page read; calibration, placement and care sections)
sources.used_for: Placement: thickest part of the food, away from bone, fat or gristle; for thin foods insert through the side to the centre; check large or irregular cuts in several places. Most food thermometers read within 2 to 4 °F; read the manufacturer instructions. Colour is not a reliable indicator that food is safe.

sources.title: Amazon Associates Central - Application review process (help)
sources.used_for: Associates require at least three qualifying sales within the first 180 days; personal orders do not count. Sites must have robust original content; the help text gives 'at least 10 posts' as a rule of thumb. Tags must be embedded in links on the sites declared in the application.
